text:
rachel (eng-sec): Heads-up: Aurelia Health POC signed up. They dropped a SIG/CAIQ v3 + short questionnaire asking about encryption key custody, SCIM provisioning, and deployment topology. They want answers + network diagram by next Tues.

ton y (sales): @rachel thanks. They're comparing Hosted vs Dedicated. Procurement wants a committed annual quote for Dedicated (guesstimate ok) and confirmation on SOC2 access.

priya (solutions): Can someone confirm if we expose SCIM PATCH for group sync? I remember we only support SCIM v2 with PATCH limited to admin roles.

rachel (eng-sec): Correct — SCIM v2 supported; write permissions scoped to org-admins only. Will note that in CAIQ responses.

alex (legal): We'll need to know whether SOC2 report is delivered post-NDA. I can draft a narrow NDA if procurement needs it today. Also flagging any data residency clauses.

infra-bot: Reminder: /get-soc2 <deal> will return a secure link if nda_signed=true.

ton y (sales): Deal ref AH-2026-221. I asked buyer to sign an NDA; they said legal is reviewing.

leo (product): For Dedicated, note the difference: isolated GPU pools + optional private VPC peering. If they want on-prem or air-gapped, lead time expands and additional certs may be required.

rachel (eng-sec): From security checklist: 1) Pre-populated SIG in our Confluence 2) Latest SOC2 Type II (2024) behind portal 3) PenTest exec summary + mitigations 4) Network diagram (hosts, control plane endpoints, peering options) 5) KMS options — managed KMS by default; HSM integrations on enterprise plan.

priya (solutions): I'll take the CAIQ fields marked "TBD/Partial" and attach evidence links. Want me to add a short remediation ETA where product changes needed?

rachel (eng-sec): Yes, add remediation note + ETA for partial controls. Also include links to our KMS integration docs.

oncall-eng: Small ops note: Dedicated in eu-central-1 single-AZ may be constrained; capacity check needed. Might add 10-14 days. Tagging eng-runtime for capacity confirmation.

priya (solutions): Also drafting a concise one-pager for procurement: SOC2 availability, pen-test date, SCIM/SAML support, encryption at-rest/in-transit, KMS/HSM options, and a ballpark annual price for Dedicated commit.

alex (legal): If they request SOC2 artifacts before NDA signed, we should provide a high-level summary only. Portal access after NDA.

rachel (eng-sec): Action items summary: - Priya: CAIQ answers + evidence links - Rachel: export network diagram and mark control plane IPs for allowlist - Leo: short note on deployment differences and lead times - Oncall-eng: capacity ping to eng-runtime - Alex: NDA + SOC2 portal gating

ton y (sales): Can we aim to have CAIQ + one-pager + diagram in this thread by Mon EOD? Procurement loop closes Tues.

rachel (eng-sec): Sounds doable. I'll upload diagram and CAIQ diffs by Mon morning.

priya (solutions): I'll post CAIQ draft and procurement one-pager in-thread once ready.

oncall-eng: Noted — i'll run the capacity check and update here.

ton y (sales): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll nudge the buyer on the NDA timeline.
